reply: JSON envelope: {ok, data | error, elapsed_ms, machine}

commands.name: ping
commands.help: Round-trip a command through the surface; the reply is the envelope.

commands.name: describe
commands.help: The whole command table as JSON: names, help, arguments, classes.

commands.name: state
commands.help: Machine counters: run state, uptime, frame gen and count, input and event counters, display mode.

commands.name: video
commands.help: Set video options; omitted keys are unchanged. Reply is as applied.
commands.args: scaling int (0 linear, 1 sharp, 2 nearest), scanlines bool, vsync int Hz, waiting int s

commands.name: pause
commands.help: Stop the virtual CPUs; the reply envelope reports the paused state.

commands.name: resume
commands.help: Continue the virtual CPUs after a pause.

commands.name: reset
commands.help: Reset the machine. Destructive: needs dangerous true.

commands.name: poweroff
commands.help: Power off the way the window close does, disc written back. Destructive: needs dangerous true.

commands.name: savevm
commands.help: Save an internal snapshot on the machine disc. Overwriting an existing name needs dangerous true.
commands.args: name str, overwrite bool, dangerous bool, waiting int s

commands.name: loadvm
commands.help: Load an internal snapshot and resume: the Machine menu path, generalised.

commands.name: listvm
commands.help: List the internal snapshots on the machine disc.

commands.name: screendump
commands.help: Write the guest framebuffer as PNG into the app support directory: the truth, no decode.

commands.name: screenshot
commands.help: Write the decoded Metal surface as PNG into the app support directory.

commands.name: key
commands.help: One key event: a macOS virtual keycode, down or up.

commands.name: type
commands.help: Type ASCII text through the US keymap, shifted punctuation included.

commands.name: mouse
commands.help: Move the pointer to guest pixel coordinates on the current screen.

commands.name: click
commands.help: Press a mouse button (0 left, 1 middle, 2 right); without down, the full click.

commands.name: wheel
commands.help: Scroll notches; positive is away from the user.

commands.name: hmp
commands.help: Run an HMP command line and return its text output: x, xp, info registers, info mtree, qom-list, gpa2hva.
commands.args: command str, core int, waiting int s

commands.name: mem
commands.help: Read guest memory, physical by default or virtual on a core; the reply is hex.
commands.args: address int, length int (1 to 1048576), virtual bool, core int

commands.name: regs
commands.help: The registers of one core as JSON: r0 to r12, sp, lr, pc, cpsr, mode.

commands.name: pc
commands.help: The program counter of one core, under the BQL.

commands.name: disa
commands.help: Disassemble instructions at an address: the HMP x command underneath.
commands.args: address int, count int (1 to 256), core int, waiting int s

commands.name: capture
commands.help: One coherent observation: pause, PC and registers, screendump, counters, then back to the prior state.
commands.args: name str, core int, waiting int s
